sentences.text: Also heard Mr. G. Alam, learned counsel for the opposite party No.2.
2. The opposite party No.2 is the wife of the petitioner herein and their marriage was solemnized on 07.03.2013 and out of their wedlock a girl child was born to them on 26.05.2014.

3. The petitioner is a Doctor by profession and stays at Basugaon, District - Chirang, BTAD, Assam,
whereas, his wife i.e., the opposite party No.2 is from Binovangar under Fatasil Ambari Police Station, Guwahati.
4.

The opposite party No.2 on 20.04.2018 submitted a written Ejahar before the Officer- in-Charge of Fatasil Ambari Police Station alleging that her husband, i.e., the petitioner herein since her marriage, physically and mentally tortured her and on number of occasions, demanded dowry in various forms.
In the said written Ejahar, it was also alleged by the opposite party No.2 that her husband, i.e., the petitioner even misbehaved with her family members including her mother and elder brother.
Ultimately, due to the compelling situation, she had to leave her matrimonial house at Basugaon on 30.04.2018 with her daughter and started residing at Guwahati.

The opposite party No.2 in her FIR also alleged that on many occasions her husband, not only physically assaulted her,
but also tried to kill her.

The said FIR of the opposite party No.2 dated 20.04.2018 was registered as Fatasil Ambari Police Station Case No. 167/2018 under Section 498A IPC corresponding to G.R. No.
5116/2018.
5.

entities.text: Fatasil Ambari Police Station Case No. 167/2018
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text:
It is seen that the petitioner earlier on 21.06.2018 obtain interim bail in said Fatasil Ambari P.S.
Case No. 167/2018 and by a subsequent order dated 27.08.2018 passed in said AB No. 1908/2018 made the said interim bail order dated 21.06.2018 absolute.

6. The main contention of the petitioner to quash the proceeding of said Fatasil Ambari Page No.#
3/4 P.S. Case No. 167/2018 is that, till filing of this criminal petition on 16.08.2021, the police neither submitted charge-sheet in said Fatasil Ambari P.S. Case No. 167/2018 nor submitted Final Report.

According to the petitioner, there is no chance of his conviction in the trial of said Fatasil Ambari P.S. Case No. 167/2018 and if it is allowed to continue, it will be an abuse of the process of Court since there are no such ingredients of Section 498A IPC in the said FIR.

7. The petitioner further submitted that the opposite party No.2, his wife filed the said FIR relating to Fatasil Ambari P.S. Case No. 167/2018 only to harass him with ulterior motive being desirous to take vengeance upon him, as he did not fulfill the demand of his wife, i.e., the opposite party No.2 to live with her at Guwahati, as she refused to leave her family members in Guwahati.

8. The petitioner further placed before the Court that he is willing to live with the family members of the opposite party No.2 for the best interest of their minor daughter, but the opposite party No.2 is refusing to consider his proposal and that if the proceeding of said Fatasil Ambari P.S. Case is allowed to continue that would bring a rift in their family.

sentences.text:
9. The petitioner submitted that he has invested sufficient amount of money in the name of his wife,
i.e., the opposite party No.2 for the best interest of their daughter and to that extent the petitioner has annexed photocopies of some of such investments made by him in the name of their minor daughter.
10. After some deliberation in the matter and as agreed by the learned counsels for the parties, both the petitioner as well as the opposite party No.2 have consented for a mediation.

11. Accordingly, both the petitioner and the opposite party No.2 shall appear for mediation before the Gauhati High Court Mediation Committee in the Principal Seat of the Gauhati High Court at Guwahati on 05.09.2024 at 10:30 am.

12. As this order has been passed in presence of the learned counsel for the petitioner Ms. A. Das as well as counsel for the opposite party No.2 Mr. G. Alam, no formal notice need be issued to the petitioner as well as opposite party No.2 for their appearance before the Gauhati High Court Mediation Committee on 05.09.2024.
Page No.# 4/4 13.
The Gauhati High Court Mediation Committee shall submit its report before the Court on or before 04.10.2024.
14. Copy of this order forthwith be forwarded to the Gauhati High Court Mediation Committee for its information and necessary action.

15. List this matter on 04.10.2024.
